scope: legacy retirement and modular monolith migration

v2_api.note: This is the SEC-02 P0 finding carried forward from Phase 0.16. Phases 0.17-0.18 neither introduced nor remediated it.

deletion_impact: None of the 16 retired classes was reachable from any route action.
migration_impact: The 3 migrated classes are referenced by 1 controller (CoverageController) and 1 provider (EventServiceProvider). The controller import was rewritten; route definitions were not touched.
